source_note: These are fictionalized game divisions, not records of actual historical votes or official current party positions. Whip positions are simulation rules for gameplay. Revisit them when balancing the game.

public_services.label: Protect public services
public_services.description: Prioritise health, education and local services.

cost_living.label: Lower the cost of living
cost_living.description: Prioritise household bills, housing costs and benefit adequacy.

climate_transport.label: Climate and transport
climate_transport.description: Prioritise clean energy, public transport and long-term environmental goals.

jobs_growth.label: Jobs, skills and growth
jobs_growth.description: Prioritise employment, training, business and regional investment.

crime_public_safety.label: Crime and public safety
crime_public_safety.description: Prioritise neighbourhood safety and effective public administration.

tax_and_spending.label: Tax and responsible spending
tax_and_spending.description: Prioritise fiscal credibility, tax fairness and long-run affordability.

integrity.label: Integrity and accountability
integrity.description: Prioritise transparency and ethical standards in public life.

divisions.title: NHS estate and equipment fund
divisions.description: The bill would fund hospital buildings, scanners and repairs, but would increase planned public borrowing. The simplified constituency pulse favours support.

divisions.title: Expand free school meals
divisions.description: The bill expands eligibility for free school meals and funds local delivery. The cost must be met through borrowing or savings elsewhere.

divisions.title: Departmental efficiency package
divisions.description: The bill requires departments to identify savings through mergers, procurement changes and reduced administrative budgets. Critics warn that some frontline services could be affected.

divisions.title: Strengthen private-renter protections
divisions.description: The bill strengthens notice and repair rules for tenants. Landlords argue that some obligations could raise costs or reduce supply.

divisions.title: Energy-bill support funded by a windfall levy
divisions.description: The package provides temporary help with energy bills, funded by a levy on exceptional energy-sector profits.

divisions.title: Uprate working-age benefits with inflation
divisions.description: The bill protects benefit purchasing power during price rises, while adding recurring pressure to public spending.

divisions.title: Restore rural and suburban bus funding
divisions.description: The bill restores grants for local bus services, especially outside major city centres.

divisions.title: Fast-track a major road-building programme
divisions.description: The bill funds new road capacity to reduce congestion. Critics argue it could lock in car dependency and crowd out rail and bus investment.

divisions.title: Accelerate renewable electricity connections
divisions.description: The bill speeds up grid connections for renewable projects and funds local network upgrades.

divisions.title: Temporary business-rates relief for high streets
divisions.description: The bill gives eligible high-street businesses temporary business-rates relief, with the cost falling on the Exchequer.

divisions.title: National apprenticeships and skills guarantee
divisions.description: The bill funds apprenticeships and retraining with employers asked to co-invest in delivery.

divisions.title: Create a regional growth and town-centre fund
divisions.description: The bill funds local transport links, derelict-site regeneration and small-business support outside the largest cities.

divisions.title: Increase neighbourhood policing grants
divisions.description: The bill funds additional neighbourhood officers and local problem-solving teams. Ministers must explain how the recurring costs will be covered.

divisions.title: Speed up asylum decisions and appeals
divisions.description: The bill adds caseworkers, sets tighter decision timetables and changes appeal processes. Supporters emphasise faster decisions; critics warn about safeguards and legal errors.

divisions.title: Raise the carbon levy on high-emission activity
divisions.description: The bill increases the price signal on high-emission activity and recycles some receipts into insulation. Some energy-intensive businesses warn about costs.

divisions.title: Require major spending bills to publish an offset plan
divisions.description: The bill requires government to publish a credible funding plan alongside major new spending commitments.

divisions.title: Temporarily restrain the state-pension uprating formula
divisions.description: The bill slows pension increases to reduce long-run spending, which would lower the real-terms support some pensioners receive.

divisions.title: Raise the defence-spending commitment
divisions.description: The bill commits to a higher defence-spending path over several years, increasing pressure on the spending review unless taxes rise or other budgets fall.

divisions.title: Publish a searchable register of ministerial interests
divisions.description: The bill expands public reporting of ministerial interests, gifts and meetings. It carries a small administrative cost and aims to improve trust.

divisions.title: Assisted-dying legislation
divisions.description: A conscience issue with ethical and legal implications. The game treats this as a free vote for all parties; members decide individually.
